meta.title: 新手必看｜让剪辑效率翻倍的4条秘诀分享
meta.title_en: 4 Secrets That Double Your Editing Efficiency (Beginner Must-Watch)

scenes.title_cn: 开场：你敢相信吗？看完这期视频，你的…
scenes.title_en: Opening: believe it or not, after this vid…
scenes.context: 写脚本能省去拍摄80%的麻烦。
sentences: 一个详尽的脚本，能帮你在拍摄中省去百分之八十以上的麻烦。
A detailed script saves over 80% of your shooting troubles.
save 80%（省去80%）
写下你的大纲、分镜和文案，拍摄时只需要按照计划执行就好。
Write outline, storyboard, and copy—then just execute the plan.
follow the plan（按计划执行）
随着AI生产能力爆发式增长，脚本的重要性一定会越来越强。
As AI production explodes, scripts will only grow more important.
scripts matter more（脚本更重要）
scenes.speak: A detailed script saves over 80% of your shooting troubles. Write outline, storyboard, and copy—then just execute the plan. As AI production explodes, scripts will only grow more important.

scenes.title_cn: 一定要用快捷键：第二，一定要用快捷键…
scenes.title_en: Use shortcuts: second, always use shortcut…
sentences: 我给你的方案是不用记，没错，不用记，直接用。
My solution: don't memorize—just use them directly.
don't memorize（不用记）
Q有个小尾巴，所以是留下后面的，W。
Q has a little tail, so it keeps what's after; W keeps what's before.
Q and W（Q和W）
Ctrl加B可以快速切一刀，左右键可以把指针快速定位到上一帧和下一帧。
Ctrl+B cuts a split; arrow keys jump frame by frame.
frame navigation（帧定位）
scenes.speak: My solution: don't memorize—just use them directly. Q has a little tail, so it keeps what's after; W keeps what's before. Ctrl+B cuts a split; arrow keys jump frame by frame.

scenes.title_cn: 一定要拍完马上剪：第三，一定要拍完马…
scenes.title_en: Edit right after shooting: third, always e…
scenes.context: 拍完马上剪，折叠电脑随身剪。
sentences: 每次拍完视频留一大堆素材，越拖你就会越不想剪。
The longer you delay, the less you want to edit.
don't delay（越拖越不想剪）
即拍即剪对提升效率很重要。
Editing right after shooting is key for efficiency.
edit instantly（即拍即剪）
展开就能用到18英寸大屏笔记本，随时随地剪辑、多场景办公也就不在话下。
An 18-inch unfoldable laptop makes editing possible anywhere.
anywhere editing（随时剪辑）
scenes.speak: The longer you delay, the less you want to edit. Editing right after shooting is key for efficiency. An 18-inch unfoldable laptop makes editing possible anywhere.

scenes.title_cn: 搭建灵感库：当然在搭配上键盘和鼠标，…
scenes.title_en: Build an inspiration library: with keyboar…
scenes.context: 灵感库让剪辑时快速决策。
sentences: 一定要搭建自己的灵感库，平时多看、多记录、多思考。
Always build an inspiration library—watch, record, think more.
inspiration library（灵感库）
在剪辑的时候才能快速列出方案、完成决策。
So when editing you can quickly list options and decide.
quick decisions（快速决策）
scenes.speak: Always build an inspiration library—watch, record, think more. So when editing you can quickly list options and decide.

practice: A detailed script saves 80% of shooting troubles.
Don't memorize shortcuts—use Q/W, Ctrl+B, arrows, Alt+G.
Instant editing keeps momentum and efficiency.
An 18-inch foldable PC enables editing anywhere.
Watch, record, think—then decide fast when editing.
pitfalls: A detailed script saves 80% of shooting troubles.
The longer you delay, the less you want to edit.
Rely on a phone for travel editing.
A foldable big-screen laptop handles anywhere editing.
外出剪辑用大屏折叠本。
Build an inspiration library for fast decisions.
shifts: 用 outline and storyboard（大纲分镜）、execute the plan（按计划执行）、AI production（AI生产）
用 Q keeps after W keeps before（Q留后W留前）、split cut（切一刀）、frame jump（帧定位）
用 edit instantly（即拍即剪）、dual screens（双屏）、waterfall screen（瀑布屏）
